account.deletion.toast.requested: Deletion request submitted — you can undo it within {days} days
account.deletion.title: Delete account
account.deletion.description: Once submitted, a {days}-day cooling-off period begins: your account keeps working and you can cancel anytime; deletion runs only after it ends and cannot be undone.
account.deletion.disposition.lost.title: Will be erased
account.deletion.disposition.lost.items: Cart, favorites, shipping addresses, unused coupons
account.deletion.disposition.kept.title: Kept anonymously
account.deletion.disposition.kept.items: The account itself (nickname becomes “Deleted user”, phone and password cleared); any shops you own stop trading
account.deletion.disposition.legal.title: Retained by law
account.deletion.disposition.legal.items: Orders, refunds and after-sales records, payment transactions — transaction records carry a separate legal retention duty; deletion erases your identity, not the ledger
account.deletion.card.descriptionRequest: Deletion requested — the account can't be restored once the cooling-off period ends.
account.deletion.card.descriptionIdle: Deletion is irreversible: you won't be able to sign in, and your data is handled as listed below.
account.deletion.card.effectiveWithTime: Takes effect around {time}; you can withdraw anytime before then.
account.deletion.card.effectiveWithoutTi: Takes effect when the cooling-off period ends; you can withdraw anytime before then.
account.deletion.card.pendingHint: Once submitted, a cooling-off period begins: your account keeps working and you can withdraw anytime; deletion runs only after it ends and cannot be undone.
account.deletion.cancel.confirmDescripti: Your account returns to normal; you can request deletion again later.
account.coupons.emptyDescription: Browse around to see coupons from the shops.
account.orders.emptyDescription: Browse around and bring home something you love.
account.profile.note: The nickname is display-only, up to {max} characters. Avatar upload is coming soon.
